title: The editor's card
logline: A business card on the drafting table under the lamp, face down, a Seattle publisher's mark on its back drawn as a blank shape. Five days after the car left. The page doesn't turn it over.

panels.composition: A business card lying face down on a drafting table under a lamp, a blank shape where a publisher's mark would be printed on its back, a brush pen beside it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a business card lying face down on a drafting table under a lamp with a blank mark printed on its back, a brush pen beside it, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
